payload.title: Multi-region replication & cross-region bus topologies
payload.description:
Explicitly out of scope for FR-4 v1. The cluster-bus contract is one bus per server; replicating across regions ("write here, sync to the bus in that other region") is deferred — current recommendation is one bus cluster per region with LB failover (horizontal-scale.md:117).

Scope (future): bus federation across regions, write-region routing, conflict handling, and region-aware failover beyond single-region N-node scale. Size: L. Depends on FR-4.
